scope: Read-only authorized repository audit; source phases/criteria/roles preserved. No mock acceptance.

rows.criterion: From October 30 the pre-opening page redirects to the public website.
rows.finding: Redirect absent; coming-soon/index.ts always maps / and /coming-soon to ComingSoon. Website scaffolding is adjacent evidence only.

rows.criterion: The close reconciles cash, card terminal and transfers against recorded payments.
rows.finding: Daily close absent. admin/FinancePage.tsx aggregates approved payment amount over periods; no counted reconciliation or close command. Card terminal mapping, received basis, cutoff/float/withdrawals/signoff/refund treatment remain owner decisions. Existing Reception/Finance conflict unresolved; no role expansion.

rows.criterion: When a class with sign-ups is cancelled, everyone is emailed and their class is returned.
rows.finding: Cancellation orchestration absent. data/sessionEditorial.ts whitelist excludes status; templates/customer cancelled state are adjacent evidence, not attendee credit or dispatch.

rows.criterion: Administration invites users, assigns the role (Front desk or Administration), changes it and removes it; the change applies immediately.
rows.finding: Dedicated team invitation/change/remove lifecycle absent. SessionProvider resolves roles; customer registration and demo switching do not satisfy staff lifecycle. Production authorization remains separate.

rows.criterion: Emails are sent from the club's domain with correct SPF, DKIM and DMARC and do not land in spam.
rows.finding: Actual domain delivery absent. admin/integrationDefs.ts disconnected fields/checklist and batch28 M04 self-only LOCAL simulation are not domain configuration, DNS verification or delivery evidence.

rows.criterion: Front desk and Administration are alerted when a customer uploads a receipt.
rows.finding: Specific staff alert absent at checked source. PG02 upload and S09 queue/deeplinks exist, but Checkout discarded receipt ID and no receipt-upload alert intent existed. Adjacent evidence alone does not promote NT03 classification. Batch36 separately implements and verifies a bounded local prototype; actual channel/destination/delivery remain unresolved.

gates: Do not equate local mock results with source acceptance or production/commercial readiness.
No real messages, payment, database, customer data, policy or role changes.
Old no-refunds versus future PG11/FI01 remains unresolved.
PC03 real receipt/bank alert channel and destination require owner decision; no inferred recipient.
